title: With 8 options or fewer the Customer chip has no search
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the asset's current owner.
  • Have a new asset for this test, asset 1, owned by customer A, with eight work orders at the test location: one for customer A billing itself and seven for customer A, each billed to a different new payer, so the chip has exactly 8 options.
custom_steps:
1. Open asset 1's Work Orders tab from customer A's page.
  2. Click the "Customer" filter chip.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • 8 rows are listed.

Step 2:

  • The chip lists its 8 options.
  • No "Search customers" box shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
